interpretation: Decomposes the deployed entity-recall gain of Reduced-HNSW over Full-HNSW. navigation_loss_full is what the in-degree law costs Full-HNSW (HNSW vs exact on the hub-laden full gallery); navigation_loss_reduced should be ~0 (the reduced gallery has no mega-hub); slot_efficiency is the cardinality effect at perfect navigation. The split shows honestly how much of §7's headline gain is navigation (the paper's mechanism) vs slot/cardinality, on the real corpus -- answering the obvious reviewer question.
